#input HCC5
```{r}
load("/data2/thanakornj/LiverOrganoid_out/output_logfile/organoid_HCC5.RData")
pwdSave = "/data2/thanakornj/LiverOrganoid_out/output_logfile/sub_HCC5.RData"

organoid.int = subset(organoid.int, subset = orig.ident == "organoid")
```

```{r}
DimPlot(object = organoid.int, reduction = 'tsne',group.by = "orig.ident")
DimPlot(object = organoid.int, reduction = 'tsne',group.by = "integrated_snn_res.0.5",label = T)
#DimPlot(object = organoid, reduction = 'tsne',group.by = "cellType",label = T)


DimPlot(object = organoid.int, reduction = 'umap',group.by = "orig.ident")
DimPlot(object = organoid.int, reduction = 'umap',group.by = "integrated_snn_res.0.5",label = T)
DimPlot(object = organoid.int, reduction = 'umap',group.by = "cellTypeTransfer",label = T)

```

```{r}
organoid.sub = SCTransform(organoid.int,vars.to.regress = c("S.Score", "G2M.Score","percent.mt"))
organoid.sub <- RunPCA(organoid.sub, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE,assay = "SCT")
organoid.sub <- RunTSNE(organoid.sub, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30,assay = "SCT")
organoid.sub <- RunUMAP(organoid.sub, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30,assay = "SCT",n.components=3)
organoid.sub <- FindNeighbors(organoid.sub, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
organoid.sub <- FindClusters(organoid.sub, resolution = 0.5)
organoid.sub <- FindClusters(organoid.sub, resolution = 0.3)
organoid.sub <- FindClusters(organoid.sub, resolution = 0.1)
```

```{r}
save(organoid.sub,file = pwdSave)
```

```{r}
DimPlot(object = organoid.sub, reduction = 'tsne',group.by = "integrated_snn_res.0.5",label = T)

```

organoid.sub = SCTransform(organoid.int,vars.to.regress = c("S.Score", "G2M.Score","percent.mt"))
organoid.sub <- RunPCA(organoid.sub, npcs = 30, verbose = FALSE,assay = "SCT")
organoid.sub <- RunTSNE(organoid.sub, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30,assay = "SCT")
organoid.sub <- RunUMAP(organoid.sub, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30,assay = "SCT",n.components=3)
organoid.sub <- FindNeighbors(organoid.sub, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:30)
organoid.sub <- FindClusters(organoid.sub, resolution = 0.5)
organoid.sub <- FindClusters(organoid.sub, resolution = 0.3)
organoid.sub <- FindClusters(organoid.sub, resolution = 0.1)
